The Modern Sleep Dilemma: Why Relaxing Is So Hard

Before exploring the mechanics of Night Switch, it is essential to understand why standard relaxation advice so often falls flat. We are frequently told to "just turn off your phone" or "drink chamomile tea." While these habits have merit, they rarely address the deep-seated mental loops and cognitive stimulation that keep our brains buzzing long after the lights go out.

When the mind is overactive, forcing it to be quiet usually produces the opposite effect. The harder you try not to think about something, the more prominent those thoughts become. What modern adults need is not more willpower, but a reliable cognitive bridge—a seamless way to guide the brain out of active problem-solving mode and into a state of deep, restorative rest.
